verdict.rationale: Claude's own docs describe Cowork scheduled tasks that "run automatically on a recurring basis, or on demand." You describe a task once and Claude handles it on your schedule, "delivering finished outputs like reports, briefings, and summaries every time." This covers recurring automated runs with results returned to the user. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of one-off tasks scheduled for a specific future time (only "on demand" is mentioned), detail on how results are delivered or notified, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
